tool_args.rationale: The pilot has only five forecast rows for a four-parameter coupled memory model. The extra-fine trajectory batch supplies the additional observations needed to identify and test that mechanism.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the coupled memory ODE to the five pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five forecast observations leave the four coupled parameters weakly identified; additional trajectory observations are warranted.
The supplied signatures and mechanism note already favor the coupled memory ODE; the trajectory batch directly improves its parameter identification.
These one-state mechanisms do not account for the observed history gap and coupled transient lag.
It does not address the identified parameter ambiguity.
